title: 38mm External Wastegate (CNC Billet Aluminum, 2-Bolt Flange, 8 PSI Spring)
description: Designed for precise boost control and preventing boost creep on high-flowing setups, this universal 38mm external wastegate diverts excess exhaust gases directly away from the turbine wheel. Constructed with a heavy-duty CNC-machined aluminum body and high-temperature valve assembly, it handles extreme exhaust gas temperatures without sticking or binding under load. It comes pre-installed with an 8 PSI actuator spring—ideal for baseline street tunes—and features a dual-port vacuum design allowing easy integration with manual or electronic boost controllers for higher PSI targets. The standard 2-bolt flange pattern makes welding or bolting onto custom T25, T3, or T4 exhaust manifolds and dump tubes straightforward.
